svg.title: Hiroki Komamiya — The engineer for teams that don’t have one.
svg.desc: A page set like a technical book: a marginalia column with the eyebrow Independent Software Engineer and Tokyo, Japan, and a text column with the headline and lead. Web apps, workflow automation, and development foundations, from requirements to operations, for companies with few or no engineers.
